topology_contract: Q/K/V/Indices values may change in place. Offsets/counts/row_map/labels changes require Attention rebuild and CUDA graph recapture. graph.replay bypasses host version checks; callers must enforce this contract.
scope: Numerical and fixed-topology graph + rebuild/recapture qualification; no performance timing or application claim.

initial_metadata.splits_semantics: Not used for partitioning; fixed chunk_tokens defines tasks. This is not the original equal-split scheme.
initial_metadata.prepare_scope: CPU metadata D2H, validation, task/table construction, H2D and owned-buffer allocation; first kernel JIT excluded.
initial_metadata.graph_topology_contract: Q/K/V and original Indices values may change in place. Replacing the plan or any plan tensor, changing tensor storage/layout, or changing offsets/labels/counts/row_map requires rebuild and graph recapture. graph.replay bypasses host identity/version checks; callers must enforce this contract.
